::: {.section-intro}
At the University of Zurich, we teach at Bachelor and Master levels, from an
introduction to the Earth system to spatial ecology, remote sensing and Earth
system modelling. We also supervise Master's theses; current topics are on
the [Research](research.qmd) page.
:::

::: {.course-list}

- [ESS101]{.course-code} **Introduction to Earth System Science**\
  Lectures and an excursion introducing the Earth as a system and the
  interactions between its components.\
  [Bachelor · Autumn semester]{.course-meta}

- [EEE334]{.course-code} **Biodiversity from Species to Landscape Scale – Concepts and Methods in Spatial Ecology and Remote Sensing**\
  Concepts and methods for studying biodiversity from species to landscape
  scale, combining spatial ecology, remote sensing and GIS in lectures,
  practicals and computer labs.\
  [Master · Autumn semester, block course]{.course-meta}

- [ESS416]{.course-code} **Earth System Modelling**\
  Concepts of Earth system modelling, with hands-on programming in computer
  labs.\
  [Master · Spring semester]{.course-meta}

:::

Course details, dates and registration are in the UZH course catalogue
[[]{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://studentservices.uzh.ch/uzh/anonym/vvz/index.html){.link-sign title="UZH course catalogue"}.

:::
